listing.name: WWE All Stars (WWE All Stars Recomp)
listing.summary: Upstream route: Upstream Windows ZIP includes runtime and first setup launcher. Setup imports/verifies own disc+TU2 and converts shaders/prepares pipelines, then game/wweallstars.exe runs. Release notification only checks, not downloads. Development source compilation is separate. Limits: Upstream only: Upstream match/control/shader-preparation claims. Full-game and multiplayer qualification not performed; release notification does not download updates. Windowsx64 Vulkan runtime/launcher builds from disc; keep gameplay claims and installer toolchain/download scope separate. Upstream platforms: Windows x64 Vulkan player ZIP. Source uses VS2026/ReXGlue; framework portability does not establish other players. Original data: Xbox360 WWE AllStars USA/Europe own ISO and supported input files. Exact source revision/hash and BIOS/firmware requirements not stated above remain Unknown in this review. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
